bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to education finance; expanding eligibility for special education separate sites funding; appropriating money; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 125A.81.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 125A.81, is amended to read:

125A.81 SPECIAL EDUCATION SEPARATE SITES AND PROGRAMS AID.

Subdivision 1.
Definition.
For purposes of this section, "special education separate site and program" means a public separate day school facility attended by students with disabilities for 50 percent or more of their school day.

Subd. 2.
Eligibility for special education separate sites and programs aid.
An education cooperative under section 471.59, education district under section 123A.15, service cooperative under section 123A.21, [-or-] intermediate school district under section 136D.01[+, or a school district site approved under subdivision 2a+] qualifies for additional state funding to special education separate sites and programs for every kindergarten through grade 12 child with a disability, as defined in section 125A.02, served in a special education separate site or program as defined in subdivision 1.

[+Subd. 2a.+]

[+School district sites.+]

[+A school district that operates a school site meeting the definition of a special education separate site and program under subdivision 1 may apply to the commissioner for funding eligibility. The district must provide information about its program in the form and manner specified by the commissioner. +]

Subd. 3.
Uses of special education separate sites and programs aid.
Additional state funding to special education separate sites and programs under this section may be used for the same purposes as are permitted for state special education aid under section 125A.76.

Subd. 4.
Special education separate sites and programs aid.
[-For fiscal year 2024 and later,-] Additional state funding to special education separate sites and programs equals $1,689 times the adjusted kindergarten through grade 12 pupil units served in special education separate sites and programs under subdivision 1.

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective for aid for fiscal year 2026 and later. +]

Sec. 2. [+APPROPRIATIONS; SPECIAL EDUCATION. +]

[+Subdivision 1.+]

[+Department of Education.+]

A bill for an act relating to education finance; expanding eligibility for special education separate sites funding; appropriating money; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 125A.81.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 125A.81, is amended to read:

125A.81 SPECIAL EDUCATION SEPARATE SITES AND PROGRAMS AID.

Subdivision 1.
Definition.
For purposes of this section, "special education separate site and program" means a public separate day school facility attended by students with disabilities for 50 percent or more of their school day.

Subd. 2.
Eligibility for special education separate sites and programs aid.
An education cooperative under section 471.59, education district under section 123A.15, service cooperative under section 123A.21, intermediate school district under section 136D.01, or a school district site approved under subdivision 2a qualifies for additional state funding to special education separate sites and programs for every kindergarten through grade 12 child with a disability, as defined in section 125A.02, served in a special education separate site or program as defined in subdivision 1.

Subd. 2a.

School district sites.

A school district that operates a school site meeting the definition of a special education separate site and program under subdivision 1 may apply to the commissioner for funding eligibility. The district must provide information about its program in the form and manner specified by the commissioner.

Subd. 3.
Uses of special education separate sites and programs aid.
Additional state funding to special education separate sites and programs under this section may be used for the same purposes as are permitted for state special education aid under section 125A.76.

Subd. 4.
Special education separate sites and programs aid.
Additional state funding to special education separate sites and programs equals $1,689 times the adjusted kindergarten through grade 12 pupil units served in special education separate sites and programs under subdivision 1.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective for aid for fiscal year 2026 and later.
